execution_authority: Root single numeric scheduler only; this protocol preparation performed no solver/checker/test/diagnostic execution.
target_selection: Provisional candidate and remaining unresolved candidate named by all nine Alpha/signed-neighbor/q1 epoch-4 records; no top-two or global-winner premise.

historical_observations.evidence_status: read from raw records only; independent physical validation deferred to scheduled process

physical_reconstruction.operator: A=I+D-W; D_ii=sum_j abs(W_ij); exact representation A16=16*A
physical_reconstruction.read_path: direct original NPZ CSR payload; no production or saved-checker imports
checks: original CSR canonical endpoint uniqueness and exact symmetry
graph weights exactly representable on physical 1/16 lattice
manifest counts, file hashes and exact opinion row/matrix hashes
each of three edits decoded from ID; independently derived root/current legality and physical weight
build physical root and parent from edge dictionaries before checking any saved operator digest
compare independently rebuilt root/parent version sequence in all nine records
recover all legal candidates as an exact canonical pair predicate and count, with original positive edges and chosen IDs excluded
physical_reconstruction.gain_coverage: Legal-domain reconstruction is not numerical certification of every candidate.

structure.support: sorted union of the two decoded candidate endpoint pairs; fixed identity elsewhere
structure.candidate_permutations: itertools.permutations(support), lexicographic order, at most 4!=24; first exact proof ends search
checks: edit kinds and physical weights equal
unordered endpoint image equals target pair
P*s=s using original exact opinion codes
P*A_parent*P^T=A_parent, every sparse integer entry and total nnz
P*A_a*P^T=A_b, independently built full child operators
structure.saved_witness_policy: Retain all nine terminal comparison/access/seed records; deduplicate identical declarations by exact JSON digest, retain all source paths, independently recheck each unique saved declaration and reject binding/algebra failures.
structure.stop_if_proven: classification=exact_equal; guaranteed g_a-g_b=[0,0]; zero floating-point solves; do not start second process

numeric.admission: Only second process; prior structural process must complete unclassified with matching code/protocol/physical-parent binding.
numeric.method: two independent direct physical child systems; parent objective cancels in g_a-g_b=J_b-J_a
numeric.approximate_backend: one SciPy splu binary64 factor per physical child; only trial generation, not a certificate
numeric.refinement: Initial binary64 child solution quantized exactly to 2^-52. At each of 80 and 112 bits, lift previous dyadic trial exactly and add one quantized binary64 correction solve from the newly recomputed exact residual. No additional iterations/precision/backends.
numeric.exact_certificate: For each dyadic q, compute F=2*s^T*q-q^T*A*q and r=s-A*q entirely in Python integers/rationals. Since physical A>=I, J=s^T*A^-1*s belongs to [F,F+||r||_2^2]. Subtract exact child intervals outward as [L_b-U_a,U_b-L_a].
numeric.rounding: Exact rational arithmetic for all certificate quantities and exact nearest/ties-even dyadic trial quantization. No mpmath or arbitrary-precision solver platform.
numeric.retention: Save every dyadic q numerator vector, exact energy, residual norm, objective bounds and each achieved difference interval; normal completion or failure never erases attained attempts.
numeric.stop: First difference interval excluding zero; exact zero residual solutions with equal objectives; otherwise after 112-bit trial or hard resource limit.

classification.separated: A guaranteed difference interval strictly excludes zero.
classification.exact_equal: A fully checked exact physical permutation relation, or both dyadic child trials are exact solutions and exact child objectives agree.
classification.unclassified: No exact relation and no guaranteed nonzero difference within the frozen finite work; overlap alone never implies equality.

full_decision_scope: This pair diagnostic does not establish strict positive gain, numerical coverage of all current legal competitors, or the global canonical winner. The field remains false even after exact_equal or separated.
v2_preservation: Inputs and raw unresolved records are read-only; no runtime resolver change, V2 rewrite, or resumed service request.
hard_stops: missing/digest-mismatched input or any original-parent/legality binding failure
invalid saved witness or exact certificate contradiction
600 seconds, 4 GiB, two-process allotment, or global cumulative budget cap reached
outputs: alpha_trial_<id>_<bits>.json if numeric fallback is admitted
